back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Son of man, set your face toward Gog of the land of Magog, the prince who is chief of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy condemning him.
And say, Thus says the Lord GOD: Behold, O Gog, I am against you, the prince who is chief of Meshech and Tubal.

I will turn you back, put a hook in your jaws, and bring you out together with all your army—both horses and horsemen clothed in full armor, a great company carrying large shields and small shields, everyone holding a sword.
Persia, Cush, and Put are with them, everyone carrying a shield and wearing a helmet.
Gomer with all its troops, Beth-togarmah from the far north with all its troops—that is, many nations that are with you.
Prepare yourself and be ready, both you and all the forces that have gathered to you, and you will be the commander overseeing them.

After a long time you will be summoned. In the latter part of the years you will come into a land that has recovered from war, a land whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel that had long lain desolate. They were brought out from the various nations, and now everyone lives in safety.
You will go up like a storm; you will come like a cloud covering the land—you, all your troops, and many nations that are with you.
Thus says the Lord GOD: On that day thoughts will arise in your heart, and you will devise an evil plan.
You will say, 'I will go up to attack a land that has unwalled villages; I will come against a quiet people who live in safety, all of them living without walls, without bars, and without gates,'

to seize spoil and plunder loot, to turn your hand against ruins that are inhabited again, and against a people gathered from the nations, who have amassed livestock and possessions, and who live at the center of the land.

Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish with all its bold young traders will say to you, 'Have you come to seize spoil? Have you mustered your hordes to plunder loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take livestock and possessions, to seize vast spoil?'
Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord GOD: On that day, when my people Israel live in safety, will you not know it?
You will come from your place, from the far north—you and many nations with you, all riding horses, a great company and a mighty army.

You will go up to attack my people Israel like a cloud covering the land. O Gog, this will happen in the last days, when I bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show my holiness through you before their eyes.

Thus says the Lord GOD: Are you not the one of whom I spoke in former days through my servants, the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for many years that I would bring you against them?
On that day, the day Gog comes against the land of Israel, my wrath will flare up—thus declares the Lord GOD.
I have spoken in my zeal and in the fire of my wrath: On that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

The fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the beasts of the field, every creeping thing that crawls on the ground, and all mankind on the face of the land will tremble before me. The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.
I will summon a sword against Gog throughout all my mountains—thus declares the Lord GOD—and each man's sword will be against his brother.
I will judge and punish him with plague and bloodshed. I will pour down driving rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur upon him, upon his troops, and upon the many nations that are with him.
I will show my greatness, show my holiness, and make myself known before the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
